_conversion.category_b_apl: Attained with Distinction (II)=4, Attained with Distinction / (I)=3, Attained=0
_conversion.category_c_from_2025: Japanese N1=7/N2=5/N3=4; Korean L6=7/L5=6/L4=5/L3=4; French/German/Spanish C2=7/C1=6/B2=5/B1=4/A2=3; Urdu A++/A+/A=7, B++=6, B+/B=5, C=4, D=3, E=2
_conversion.csd: Citizenship and Social Development is excluded from the admission score
_conversion.best_five: Sum of the best five subjects (core or elective, CSD excluded), subject weightings applied per programme

_meta.scores_basis: 2026 intake (main round), weighted Best-5 scores as published by EdUHK on 15 Oct 2026
_meta.weights_basis: 2027-entry weighting column of the same EdUHK PDF (authoritative for 2027 entry)
_meta.not_published: EdUHK publishes Lower Quartile and Median only: no UQ and no overall mean (the PDF's 'mean score of specific HKDSE subject' is a per-subject figure, not an overall mean) -> uq/mean are null

revised_2027_weights_reference_scores.JS8012: EdUHK also prints 2027-weighted reference scores: Lower Quartile 26.5, Median 27.5
revised_2027_weights_reference_scores.JS8702: EdUHK also prints 2027-weighted reference scores: Lower Quartile 26.4, Median 26.6

_meta.high_proficiency_note: JS8003/JS8004/JS8005/JS8674/JS8675 carry an EdUHK remark that the programme requires high Chinese or English proficiency and that the subject requirement cannot be substituted; the formal JUPAS table still lists level 3, which is what is recorded here
_meta.subject_note: 'Specified ApL subject(s)' is EdUHK's placeholder for its list of weighted Applied Learning subjects (see EdUHK_ApL_Recognition_and_Subject_Weightings.pdf); ApL is not a Category A subject so no canonical name applies
_meta.elective_note: elect1/elect2 hold the two elective slots of the 332A22 baseline; a constrained slot lists the accepted subjects, 'Any' means any elective. JS8507 (Higher Diploma) requires any 3 electives, expressed as elect1.count=3 with elect2 empty
_meta.best_of_note: best_of_weights_2027 lists groups where only the best ONE subject of the group earns the weighting
